## Services

- [GoHighLevel Solutions](https://sohailworks.com/#services): GoHighLevel expert — funnels, landing pages, CRM and pipeline setup, workflow automation, missed-call text-back, booking and appointment automation, lead nurturing and follow-up systems.
- [WordPress Development](https://sohailworks.com/#services): Custom WordPress websites, Elementor and Elementor Pro, WooCommerce development, custom themes, performance and responsive optimisation.
- [React and Next.js Development](https://sohailworks.com/#services): React.js development, Next.js websites and applications, responsive UI, reusable components, API integration.
